evidence: Extensively updates wallet spend, coin selection, fee bumping, transaction persistence, and wallet database logic in src/wallet/ to handle BIP 352 recipients.
rationale: Adds wallet and RPC support for sending to BIP 352 Silent Payment addresses across send, sendtoaddress, sendmany, and sendall. This delivers a substantial privacy and usability feature that integrates dynamic ECDH Taproot output derivation and persistent recipient metadata for fee bumps into the Core wallet.
